business_problem: Poloplast needed to replace monthly spreadsheet forecasting and disconnected ERP processes that made supply-chain planning reactive, labor intensive, and poorly aligned with production.
solution_summary: Poloplast adopted Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management and the new Demand planning capability to turn forecasting into a collaborative, data-driven process rather than a rearview-mirror exercise. Key components include Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management anchors ERP, item availability, and downstream supply-chain execution on the same platform as forecasting; Demand planning provides the forecasting algorithms, reports, and collaborative user experience for forward-looking planning; Power Platform underpins the low-code demand-planning experience used by business teams. Poloplast extended its planning horizon from three months to one and a half years with a single click, reduced external storage costs, improved purchasing precision, and kept customer service levels high with less wasteful stock and ordering.
